text:
Jun: FYI — EU had a transient S3 flurry and our kafka commits lagged. Hourly aggregates are stale for ~36h. I think a staggered recompute is cleaner than another full shard blast. Thoughts?
Omar: +1. last full recompute destroyed budget. Prefer windows + deterministic sampling.
Leah: agree. Console needs a dry-run estimate before operators kick anything. They keep starting replays blind.
Kai: propose three-tier plan: hot=last 6h (full, atomic), warm=6-72h (sampled, partial commits), cold=>72h skip by default. Canary hot on 1% tenants first.
Ryan: runner should tag origin (origin=s3-eu-3141) and emit x-replay-id header so tracing & billing can link spikes to the run.
sre-bot: incident resolved: ingest-eu-s3-3141500000 ~45m ago.
Jun: also we should run a cheap dedupe probe: diff event_ingest_time vs aggregate_ts and skip keys that are already up-to-date. Saves compute.
Omar: deterministic selector example: hash(tenant_id||hour||seed) % 100 < 10. Include seed in YAML so sampling repros.
Leah: Console dry-run fields: estimate_cpu_hours, est_rows_touched, est_s3_gb, est_duration, est_cost_usd. Add an auto-abort if cost > threshold checkbox.
Kai: sample SQL prototype:
```
SELECT tenant_id, hour
FROM telemetry_hour_index
WHERE hour > now() - interval '72 hours'
  AND (abs(hash_text(concat(tenant_id, hour, '314159')) ) % 100) < 10
```
Plugs into job runner.
Ryan: add per-tenant caps for warm window: max_slots_per_tenant=2 and global_warm_concurrency=40 so big tenants don't hog samples.
Jun: commit strategy: hot atomic (staging swap), warm partial commits so ops see incremental improvements and can abort. Also enable regression_check on canary with golden queries.
Leah: devex: provide a one-click Console template "EU staggered recompute" prefilled with policy and a warning banner.
Omar: add backfill_meta: {replay_seed, replay_id} to logs. Also ensure watermark uses event_ingest_time not arrival_time.
Jun: quick config draft for ops to trial:
```
policy: staggered_recompute_v1
hot_window: 6h
warm_window: 72h
hot_coverage_pct: 100
warm_sample_pct: 10
global_warm_concurrency: 40
max_slots_per_tenant: 2
commit_mode_hot: atomic
commit_mode_warm: partial
replay_seed: 314159
trace_header: x-replay-id
auto_abort_cost_usd: 400
regression_check_enabled: true
```
console-bot: dry-run endpoint: POST /api/replay/dryrun -> returns {estimate_cpu_hours, estimate_s3_gb, rows_touched, est_cost_usd}. Provide job YAML.
Ryan: I'll add origin tagging + staging-swap commit in runner. ETA EOD.
Omar: I'll review dry-run cost calc PR.
Leah: I'll draft Console copy and the one-click template.
Jun: plan: wire dry-run + canary for hot window, validate regressions, then run hot full, then warm sampled sweep. Ping #eng-sre if anything spikes. Thanks all.
